subregion.name: The Central Chambers
subregion.summary: A connected maze of wide halls and rocky rooms spanning the cave's central interior.

subregion.name: The Eastern Fissures
subregion.summary: A compact cluster of narrow passages and alcoves tucked along the eastern wall.

subregion.name: The Sunken Hollows
subregion.summary: A deep, sprawling network of damp caverns and passages winding south through the western reaches.

room.title: muddy passage
room.body: A narrow mud path between dark cave walls, lined with ferns and clusters of mushrooms.

room.title: bone litter passage
room.body: A damp mud cavern floor strewn with bone fragments and ash along a dark rock wall.

room.title: muddy cave passage
room.body: A muddy cave floor flanked by rocky walls, with hanging vines and patches of mushrooms along the edges.

room.title: hanging vine cavern
room.body: A wide mud cavern floor under hanging vines, with root clusters and mushroom patches along the rock walls.

room.title: fern passage
room.body: Mud and green ferns line the cave floor alongside rocky walls and clusters of mushrooms.

room.title: shelf mushroom cavern
room.body: Mud and fern patches under hanging vines, beside a rock wall thick with roots and shelf mushrooms.

room.title: canopy alcove
room.body: Damp cave mud and fern patches beneath a makeshift hide canopy, lined with animal skulls.

room.title: ruined campsite
room.body: Muddy cave ground around a cooking fire with pots, strewn with bedrolls, corpses, and wrecked camp clutter.

room.title: hanging vine cavern 4
room.body: Damp mud and tangled roots under hanging vines, with wooden support beams along one side.

room.title: muddy root passage
room.body: A muddy cave floor between rock walls covered in thick roots and shelf mushrooms.

room.title: cauldron hollow
room.body: Damp cavern mud beneath hanging vines, scattered with blood and bones around a large cauldron.

room.title: palisade passage
room.body: Mud and ferns under hanging cave vines, bordered by spiked wooden palisades.

room.title: timber walkway
room.body: A wooden plank walkway framed by heavy timber beams along the cavern rock.

room.title: roasting spit cavern
room.body: Damp cave mud with a meat spit over a fire pit and a wooden stake palisade.

room.title: meat spit camp
room.body: Damp cave mud and bone litter around a meat spit over a small fire, with hanging vines along the rock walls.

room.title: timbered cavern passage
room.body: A mud cavern passage with wooden floorboards under heavy timber support frames.

room.title: hanging vine passage
room.body: A muddy cave passage with hanging vines and shelf mushrooms along the rock wall.

room.title: hanging vine cavern 2
room.body: A muddy cavern floor beneath hanging vines, with patches of weeds and mushroom clusters along the rock walls.

room.title: slith totem hollow
room.body: A muddy cavern floor with hanging vines overhead, bloodied ground, and crude bone totems set near the rock walls.

room.title: hanging vine cavern 3
room.body: A mud-floored cavern with long vines hanging from the ceiling and clusters of shelf mushrooms clinging to the rock walls.

room.title: shelf mushroom passage
room.body: A damp mud cavern passage beside a rock wall thick with shelf mushrooms and dangling roots.

room.title: rooted cavern passage
room.body: A narrow passage of damp mud and exposed roots between sheer cave walls.

room.title: shelf fungus passage
room.body: A dirt and root-strewn cave floor between rocky walls lined with shelf fungi and root clusters.

room.title: slith totem passage
room.body: A dirt cave passage lit by a standing torch next to a slith totem.

room.title: slith totem hall
room.body: Gravelly dirt strewn with bones and impaled corpses beneath a burning torch and slith totem.

room.title: impaled corpse passage
room.body: Gravelly dirt ground between rough rock walls, with an impaled corpse and dark mushrooms.

room.title: bonepile hollow
room.body: Gravel and ash ground littered with bone piles, severed corpses, and blood spatters against the rock walls.

room.title: hanging vine passage
room.body: A dirt cave passage with patchy moss under hanging vines, with shelf mushrooms along the rock wall.

room.title: curved earthen passage
room.body: A curved dirt passage between rocky cave walls, with patches of ferns and shelf mushrooms growing along the edge.

room.title: cavern campfire
room.body: Gravelly dirt floor beside a burning campfire with a meat skewer and wooden barrels.

room.title: campfire clearing
room.body: Dirt ground around a burning campfire, surrounded by corpses, bloodstains, and mushroom clusters along the cave walls.

room.title: totem shrine chamber
room.body: Gravelly dirt and bone piles under hanging vines, facing a wall of wooden totems.

room.title: shelf mushroom passage
room.body: A gravelly dirt passage under rock walls layered with shelf mushrooms and thick tree roots.

room.title: hanging vine chamber 2
room.body: Gravelly dirt floor in a wide cave chamber, with hanging vines overhead and mushroom patches along the rock walls.

room.title: hanging vine chamber
room.body: A gravelly dirt cavern floor with patchy weeds and moss, beneath hanging vines and clusters of mushrooms.

room.title: mushroom cluster hall
room.body: A wide mud and dirt cavern with hanging vines overhead and a patch of mushrooms in the center.

room.title: hanging vine hollow
room.body: Gravelly dirt ground beneath hanging ceiling vines, bordered by rock and fern patches.

room.title: shelf mushroom hall
room.body: A dirt and mud cave chamber with stalagmites rising along the rock walls and shelf mushrooms clustered overhead.

room.title: slith burrow chamber
room.body: A dirt cave floor dominated by a large burrow of tangled roots and bone totems.

room.title: tendril passage
room.body: A muddy dirt path between high rock walls, with pale mushroom tendrils growing along the edges.

room.title: hanging vine chamber 3
room.body: A dirt floor cavern draped with long hanging vines, bordered by rock walls and patches of mushrooms.

room.title: meat spit chamber
room.body: Cave mud and gravel under hanging vines, with a meat spit over a campfire and clusters of mushrooms against the walls.

room.title: dirt cave corridor
room.body: A gravelly dirt floor between dark cave walls, fringed with low weeds and fern patches.

room.title: alcove campsite
room.body: Dirt ground in a cave alcove, with a cooking campfire, bedrolls, and a wooden lean-to against the rock wall.

room.title: fissure passage 2
room.body: A dirt cave passage flanked by rough rock walls, with clusters of mushrooms on the ground.

room.title: hanging vine cavern
room.body: Dirt and moss cover the cavern floor beneath hanging vines. Mushroom clusters sprout along the rocky walls near a loaded wooden cart.

room.title: fissure bridge landing
room.body: A dirt clearing beside a wooden plank bridge built over the cavern chasm, with hanging vines overhead.

room.title: hanging vine passage
room.body: Forest dirt and moss along the cavern wall, with patches of mushrooms, hanging vines, and a cloth canopy.

room.title: fissure passage
room.body: Dirt and moss along a rock wall beneath hanging vines.

room.title: fissure campsite
room.body: A dirt floor lit by a burning campfire, with thick vines hanging from the ceiling above.

room.title: torchlit plank bridge
room.body: A section of rough wooden plank bridge over the dark chasm, lit by a single standing torch.

room.title: fissure scaffolding
room.body: A dirt cave floor bordered by rock ledges, with wooden scaffolding and crates along the drop.

room.title: mushroom outcrop
room.body: A dirt-topped rock outcrop covered with clusters of red and yellow mushrooms, beneath hanging vines.

room.title: webbed dirt ledge
room.body: A dirt ledge against rocky cave walls draped in cobwebs, overlooking a wooden plank walkway.
